lines.text: A man in the crowd asks Jesus to tell his brother to divide the inheritance, but Jesus declines to judge between them.
Jesus warns them to guard against every form of pride, because life does not consist in having many possessions.
A rich man's ground produces an abundance, and he has nowhere to store his crops.
He plans to tear down his barns and build bigger ones, then sell his grain and tell himself to take it easy.

wrong_details.true: store up all his grain and his goods

lines.text: God calls him a fool, says his life is required that night, and asks who will own what he accumulated.
